title: Devin must never touch the database outside the lab

customer.name: Dev Okafor
customer.role: Merchandiser and part-time DBA, Lumen Home

voice: Last quarter a well-meaning migration relaxed a NOT NULL on orders and the fulfilment worker crashed on the first new order after deploy. Nobody reviewed it carefully because it looked harmless.

Now we are letting an AI agent work in this repository. I want hard guarantees, not a policy document: it must never run db:seed --reset or a migration against anything but the lab database, and every psql must go through our read-only wrapper.
Show me the guard blocking a bad migration before it reaches the database — and show me what happens when the guard itself is misconfigured.

money.note: Preventive; the last incident cost ≈6 h of fulfilment downtime

impact.trust: Platform team approval to let Devin work in services/ depends on this

constraints: Guards live in the repository, not in anyone's personal settings
